study: studies/identifiability/local-dependence-checks (ld_checks.py) -- Paper II F6: standard LD indexes and a bifactor re-scan beside the pairwise scan
note: Pre-registered at 018e286 before any real number; synthetic floor committed at 76dd563. (a) STATISTIC, reading PARTLY ANSWERABLE: under the same refitted parametric bootstrap (replayed draw for draw; the committed scan reproduces exactly, 12 of 12 pairs), Chen-Thissen G2 passes its floor (PAIR 1.00, fitted-model FP 0.000) and fires in 8 of 15 XES3G5M sets (binomial p = 1.8e-7), 10 of its 12 flagged pairs the committed ones (pooled Jaccard 0.71 [0.43, 1.00], 15 sets resampled), per-set verdict agreement 13/15 (kappa 0.73), adjacency 3 of 12 (p = 0.0013). Mean-centred Q3 FAILS its floor (PAIR median 0.60; 0.07-0.40 in sets 10-14) and is UNANSWERABLE. ASSISTments 2012: all statistics UNANSWERABLE (floor fails, 2 sets). (b) UNIT OR PAIR, verdict MIXED: bifactor 2PL with one group factor per depth-2 taxonomy parent (module, groups >= 3 skills), pairwise (limited-information) likelihood; floor passes (BF plant detection median 1.00 within and cross, real and synthetic; group-only false alarm 0.05; real fitted-model FP 0.033); group-free world false alarm 0.15 triggers the pre-registered downgrade of any PAIR-SPECIFIC reading. Against a same-estimator one-trait arm, module factors cut sets firing 10 -> 5 (still p = 0.00061) and flagged pairs 24 -> 9; 3 of 5 testable within-module committed pairs survive (0.60 [0.15, 0.95]; cross-module churn control 4 of 5); adjacency enrichment not significant under BF (1 of 9, p = 0.16) nor in the reference arm (p = 0.054). F6 may cite G2 beside the scan; it keeps its wording on unit versus pair and says a module factor was not excluded. Moves nothing.
